findings.description: The KMS key does not have automatic key rotation enabled (enable_key_rotation is not set to true), which increases the risk associated with long-term use of a single cryptographic key and violates best practices for key management.

No explicit key policy is defined for this KMS key, so it falls back to the default AWS KMS policy that grants full access to the root account and effectively all IAM principals with appropriate IAM permissions, which can lead to overly broad access to encrypt/decrypt data protected by this key.
